## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Every critical competency is assessed.
- [ ] Scenario independence is demonstrated.
- [ ] Aids and integrity controls are explicit.
- [ ] Evidence and critical criteria are unambiguous.
- [ ] Outcomes do not depend only on completion or score.
- [ ] Retry behavior preserves history.
- [ ] Technical, assessment, and architecture review passed.
